summary: Updated Query.fragment to include self._path in the query identity tuple alongside the frozen document mapping. This prevents fragment queries with identical values on distinct field paths from comparing equal or colliding in Table query caches. Added unit and regression tests in tests/test_autose_issue_2.py covering AC-1 through AC-5 as well as path compatibility checks.
